mapper.sql: output_id AS outputId, flow_version_id AS flowVersionId, node_id AS nodeId, output_code AS outputCode, output_value AS outputValue, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_decision_flow_end_output(output_id, flow_version_id, node_id, output_code, output_value, create_time) VALUES(#{row.outputId}, #{row.flowVersionId}, #{row.nodeId}, #{row.outputCode}, #{row.outputValue}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_decision_flow_end_output WHERE flow_version_id = #{flowVersionId} ORDER BY node_id, output_code LIMIT 501
